neighbours.label: Late Roman Empire under barbarian pressure: 3rd-5th century AD invasions, raids and the fall of the West (Goths, Vandals, Saxons, Franks, Huns), peaking just before an invader, emperor or date is named
fire: In 406 the Rhine froze and the Vandals, Alans and Suebi poured into Gaul.
The Western Empire finally fell in 476 when Odoacer deposed the last emperor.
Stilicho spent his career holding back the Goths on the frontiers of Italy.
Britain was left to fend off the Picts and Saxons after the legions withdrew in 410.
The Ostrogoths under Theodoric took Ravenna from Odoacer in 493.
Aurelian walled the city of Rome in the 270s as Germanic raids grew bolder.
The Franks crossed the lower Rhine and settled in Toxandria in the 4th century.
Gaiseric's Vandals sailed from Carthage and plundered Rome in 455.
quiet: In 52 BC Vercingetorix united the Gauls against Caesar at Alesia.
The Republic finally ended in 27 BC when Octavian became Augustus.
Scipio spent his career fighting Carthage in Spain and Africa.
Britain was conquered by Claudius after the legions landed in AD 43.
The Normans under William took England from Harold in 1066.
Trajan built his forum in the 110s as the empire reached its greatest extent.
The Mongols crossed the Volga and settled on the steppe in the 13th century.
Drake's fleet sailed from Plymouth and plundered Cádiz in 1587.

predictions: Fire median ~0.45 (probe: Alaric 0.57, Adrianople 0.52, Saxon raiders 0.48, Vandals 0.37; Huns only 0.21). Roman Republic and early Empire twins <=0.1 (Caesar 0.09); medieval and modern invasions <=0.1 (Vikings 0.10, Napoleon 0.01).
notes: Card: barbarian invaders of the Roman Empire 386, barbarian raids since AD 360, invading Sueves 468, Alaric 410, Visigoths destroyed Rome, Saxon raiders 2nd-3rd centuries AD. Peaks fall on ' the', ' Al', ' Car', a space before a date: the unit anticipates the name or date in this period.
